title: GBRG Graph Edge
description: A typed, weighted relationship between two SemanticCells. Orientation: `from` DEPENDS ON `to` (for a call B->A, from=B, to=A).

record_type.$comment: Optional dataset line-type discriminator (gbrg-blast-radius.jsonl multiplexes SemanticCell and GraphEdge lines). Allowed so raw dataset edge records validate as-is; absent on an edge handed in on its own. Mirrors the optional record_type on the pattern SemanticCell branch. See docs/ADR-002-pattern-cells.md.

kind.description: Mapped to the graphdb edge label (CALLS, INHERITS, IMPORTS, TESTED_BY, CHURNS_WITH).

weight.$comment: graphdb properties are NODE-scoped, so weight CANNOT be a graphdb edge property. GBRG persists it in an explicit side map keyed by (from, to, label) — see gbrg-core::EdgeWeights and docs/ADR-001. It is carried here in the wire contract only.

line.$comment: Optional source line of the usage site. In the REGEX-corpus projection, each `code -> rx` `imports` edge is one usage site expanded from a pattern record's sources[] (its {repo,file,line}); the same pattern used on N lines yields N edges. Not a graphdb edge property; carried in the wire/projection contract only.
